notes: Site is a NetSuite SCA storefront (Backbone.js client-rendered SPA); plain HTTP fetch returns an empty shell, so Playwright (headless Chromium) was used to render pages, per prior-pass access notes. Found a single Best Sellers PLP in main nav: 'BEST SELLERS' -> https://www.scullyandscully.com/inspiration/best-sellers. Confirmed via WebFetch (breadcrumb 'Home > Inspiration > Best Sellers', main heading 'Best Sellers', real shoppable grid with sort/filter/pagination) and independently via Playwright reading the site's own .facets-facet-browse-title[data-quantity] attribute, which returned 113 in two separate runs, matching WebFetch's rendered '#### 113 Products' header. Checked: main nav, footer nav, full sitemap.xml (24,365 URLs) for best-sell*/top-sell*/popular*/trending*/customer-favorite* patterns -- no additional Bestsellers PLPs found beyond this one (the sitemap itself does not even list this URL, likely noindex, but it is live and reachable via nav). No genuine sub-structure (no 'Furniture Bestsellers' / 'Home Decor Bestsellers' children) -- single undifferentiated listing.

rows.evidence: Rendered listing header '#### 113 Products'; corroborated by data-quantity="113" on .facets-facet-browse-title (Playwright, 2 independent runs)
